name: Regulation (EC) No 261/2004
notes: Provisional EU reform agreed June 2026 preserves €250-€600 tiers and 3-hour delay threshold; expected implementation in 2027. Current EC 261/2004 applies to present claims.

distance_bands.description: Intra-Community flights over 1,500 km, or other flights between 1,500 km and 3,500 km
All flights not falling under Band 1 or Band 2 (over 3,500 km)

between_7_and_14_days.exemption_condition: Rerouting offered departs <= 2h before original and arrives < 4h after original scheduled arrival

less_than_7_days.exemption_condition: Rerouting offered departs <= 1h before original and arrives < 2h after original scheduled arrival
